text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day. On the academy track, Inari One and the junior Horse Girl were doing laps on the dirt course.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho!? Another new personal best!
You're shootin' straight to the top!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! T-R-U-T-H is...
That hurdle racing DVD I borrowed from you, Inari-senpai!
I used it as a reference for my leg drive!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Look at 'em, doing great again today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, looks like my job here is officially—
Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Sorry, Senpai!
Long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...What's up? Calling me out at a time like this...

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually... tomorrow!
I'm running in a mock race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ? Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
So—race with me!!
Turf, 2200 meters!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, I'm completely lost.
A practice race right now!? On turf, no less!?

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Please, Tamamo-senpai!
It's... really important to me!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Always so pushy, ain'tcha.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guess I got no choice.
—I ain't holdin' back, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Gh... haaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*—Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Totally crushed, totally crushed!
Tamamo-senpai, you really are crazy fast~!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
... ...I don't really get it.
You satisfied now? Think this'll help ya do your best tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Of course!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I got the front-row seat. I got to watch from closer than anyone else!
Your back, Senpai, running with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: In the end... I couldn't copy your running style one bit.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Heart.
Now, and always, a heart that gives its absolute all.
I'm definitely gonna copy your heart, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna run with everything I've got, too!
—On turf, on dirt, no matter where I am!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Look at you talkin' big.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll be waitin'. Go seize that glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day. I met up with Tamamo Cross and the others in the stands for the mock race. Crossing the finish line in first place before our eyes was...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Keep goin', keep goin', just like that...
Alright!! HELL YEAH~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible performance!
A front-running masterclass with everything on the line!
She takes a glorious first place~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Front runner and betweener. Their form and their running styles.
The two of them are completely different, but there's no mistaking it!
That fighting spirit, dedicating everything, that very stance is—
choice_data_list: Spitting image of you, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha.
Heck, hearin' ya say that makes me kinda blush, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that look on her face after pullin' up...
Ain't a bad look at all!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to her future!
Looking forward to her future, aren't you!
Looks like your feelings were passed on to her.
Looks like your feelings were passed on to her, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that look on her face after pullin' up...
Ain't a bad look at all!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to her future!
Looking forward to her future, aren't you!
Looks like your feelings were passed on to her.
Looks like your feelings were passed on to her, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Keep yer eyes peeled...
'Cause she's gonna blow yer mind for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehe, ya think so~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Haha! Yer darn right!
